items.title: Why Are CSX (CSX) Shares Soaring Today
items.summary: Shares of freight rail services provider CSX (NASDAQ:CSX) jumped 5.6% in the afternoon session after the company reported better-than-expected second-quarter financial results.

items.title: Industrial Stocks And This ETF Claw Gains From A Falling Market
items.summary: Industrial stocks bucked a falling market on Thursday. The State Street Industrial Select Sector SPDR ETF popped back into in a buy zone, led by gap-ups and breakouts for CSX, RTX and others. Many holdings in this exchange traded fund delivered blowout earnings this week.

items.title: CSX Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Up Y/Y, EPS View Raised
items.summary: CSX posts strong Q2 2026 beat, with EPS up 22.7% and revenues rising 10.1%, driven by volume, pricing and fuel surcharge gains despite coal export headwinds.

items.title: Railroad Stocks Rally as More Cargo Moves From Trucks to Trains
items.summary: Shares of freight railroads Union Pacific, CSX and Norfolk Southern jumped after they reported higher revenue, as more shippers moved their cargo from truck to rail.  “I’m very bullish from where we sit on demand,” said Union Pacific Executive Vice President Kenny Rocker in an earnings call.  Union Pacific reported a 12% increase in second-quarter operating revenue compared to the same period a year ago, CSX reported a 10% increase and Norfolk Southern, an 11% increase.

items.title: CSX boosts outlook on higher volume and revenue
items.summary: CSX raised its full-year outlook after a rebound in demand that saw increases in volume, revenue and income. The post CSX boosts outlook on higher volume and revenue appeared first on FreightWaves.
